tasks: Assess the seismic hazard for a site 15 km from an active strike-slip fault with a slip rate of 8 mm/yr and maximum credible earthquake M7.2. Estimate the 475-year return period PGA.
Evaluate the earthquake hazard at a location 18 km from a strike-slip fault slipping at 7.5 mm/yr with Mmax=7.0. Calculate the probabilistic ground motion for 10% exceedance in 50 years.
Analyze the ground motion prediction for a M6.5 earthquake at 25 km epicentral distance on a VS30=360 m/s site. Compare NGA-West2 GMPE estimates for PGA and SA at 0.2s and 1.0s.
Estimate ground shaking from a M6.3 event at 28 km distance on a site with VS30=380 m/s using multiple ground motion models. Quantify epistemic uncertainty in spectral acceleration.
